# Catalogue 657: Bernstorff to the Auswaertiges Amt, Washington 10 Jan 1917, sent by the State Department on 11 Jan 1917
# as its telegram to the American Embassy in Berlin ("Please deliver following cipher to Foreign Office").
# Source: NARA RG 59, decimal file 763.72111/4443, microfilm M367 roll 166 (naId 27179174), frames 0785 (sheet "1.")
# and 0786 (sheet "2.").
# The groups as typed, row by row as on the sheets. Read from the scans with a vision-capable language model;
# about 117 groups re-read independently at full resolution (116 agree; the one open case is marked below).
# Conventions: [?] = doubtful reading; {x} = struck through on the original (not a group); (...) = a note on a
# correction or a pencil mark, not a group. The typeface confuses 5, 6 and 8 (6 has an open hooked top, 8 is
# closed and S-like). Pencil running tallies in the margin (/199, /302 ...; sheet totals) are a clerk's count for
# charging, not part of the message. Frame 0786 is not a reversed image: it is sheet 2, ending with
# "DEPARTMENT OF STATE JAN 11 1917 APPROVED Robert Lansing".
# Corrections made during the work: group 20 reads 8918 (closed 8, as in 8559 next to it), not 6918;
# group 40 reads 88789 (like 8789 at group 27), not 88769.
# Count: 577 groups = 505 of four figures, 67 of five, 4 of three (the head) and 1 of six (group 377, 108609[?]).
# Groups 0-146 are telegram No. 205 (ciphertext_tel205.txt); groups 147-576 are a second text (ciphertext_part2.txt).
# Group numbers (0-based) are printed by decode.py.
